integrity.method: SHA-256 via Python hashlib. Read original PNG IHDR/eXIf and JPEG SOF/Exif directly with standard-library binary parsing; no decode/re-encode or image file modification.

integrity.encodingLimit: JPEG80 is the supplied/indexed export setting. This review independently checks bytes/hashes, dimensions, EXIF and visible correspondence; it does not reconstruct the encoder quality setting. Tool previews may be resized for display, while integrity reads original file bytes.

visualReasons: Each retained JPEG preserves its exact raw composition and essential native score, target, forecast, locator, control or specimen ink. Compression modestly smooths fine scenic texture and glow, with no consequential missing stroke, clipped value or altered state observed.

Native phone and tablet images preserve the approved Play hierarchy: continuous scenery, readable localized instruments, small utilities and distinct actual stars. Busy/selected/context changes remain visibly distinguishable within their own owners.

The three contact samples have visibly different material responses, not merely different timestamps: circles around Pause and Help, and a rounded filled first forecast chip. The exported artwork/text stays complete and apparently stable in proportion.

The corrected hosted AX5 before/busy pair is star-bearing in both images, preserves its complete exact facts and visibly mutes Help only. It remains a static held-presenter test context; no production movement or disabled-touch assurance is derived from it.

Both specimen exports preserve the registered caller sizes and complete digits, with test annotations and selected/disabled roles plainly labeled. They are not passed off as native screens or platform focus evidence.
No duplicate, misleading opening/selected substitution, orientation error, context mismatch or export-specific visible failure was found in these final thirteen entries.

limits: This is bounded static raw/export acceptance. Native interaction, exact saved round, hit-target floor, clocks and earned-event provenance remain separate mechanical evidence.

Contact raw PNGs were decoded from compressed native H264 footage. The retained JPEG adds a second encoding step. Visible materials survive, but no pixel-exact glyph geometry, contrast ratio, continuous animation, finger latency or physical recognition claim is made.

The selected underline/column locator is persistent selection, not platform focus. Platform focus, actual native disabled-touch rejection, actual VoiceOver, Increased Contrast, Reduced Transparency, minimum-iOS and physical-device states are unperformed here.

Hosted roots explicitly render committed scene snapshots while the real Store presenter callback is held. They establish visible busy treatment and stable header only within that test; they do not establish a production animation pose or actual native disabled contact.

Utility and forecast canvases contain test-only annotation/layout and supplied disabled variants. Their resting/disabled appearance is not native focus, press/cancel or every live control-state proof.
Tablet guide excerpts are reviewed only where captured. Partial content at the viewport edge does not claim simultaneous visibility of every line or independent scroll reachability.

Full Board frame is at zero before the later 42,000 refill; no refill screenshot is substituted. Current Seed4/Frostfruit8 labels retain their current 11,000/15,000-point context and are not historical 18-light fixtures.

Source-bound passes do not cover every backdrop, viewport or user preference. Prior intermittent reader-pan failures remain source-bound residuals with cause unassigned; this export work does not fix or diagnose them.
verificationPerformed: Read-only original file/source/index inspection and one new JSON review record only. No App/test edits, controller operations, builds, image transformations or exports.
